stories.name: Prospect Inbound Pipeline with ACE Enrichment
stories.rationale: Delivered a full end-to-end prospect inbound pipeline with ACE enrichment and a settings UI to automate and streamline partner lead intake.

stories.name: Centralized Admin Tools Hub
stories.rationale: Built a centralized admin tools page and regenerated supporting docs and tests to give internal teams a unified operational interface post-refactor.

stories.name: Milestone Rebranding and Legacy Cleanup
stories.rationale: Removed legacy gaps code and renamed 'Goals' to 'Milestones' to align the platform's language with current product terminology.

stories.name: AWS Service and Product Catalog Expansion
stories.rationale: Expanded the AWS product catalog data and enabled selection of more AWS services so customers can map their architectures more completely.

stories.name: Outcomes Page Overhaul
stories.rationale: Rebuilt and stabilized the Outcomes page by updating its design, removing outdated content, and fixing a caching issue that caused stale data to display.

stories.name: User Session Stability and Access Control
stories.rationale: Improved user session handling to prevent 403 errors and introduced a hard-lock mechanism to disable login for specific users, strengthening platform access control.

stories.name: Competitive Analysis Enhancements
stories.rationale: Improved the AI-driven competitive analysis feature to deliver more accurate and actionable competitive intelligence for users.

stories.name: Marketplace Readiness and Discovery Fixes
stories.rationale: Fixed seller matching in Marketplace Discovery and addressed legacy tooling issues to ensure readiness assessments reflect accurate marketplace eligibility.

stories.name: ISV Industry Targeting Support
stories.rationale: Added ISV as a selectable target industry so independent software vendors can be properly categorized during assessments.

stories.name: Portfolio Company Drill-Down Navigation Fix
stories.rationale: Added an exit chip to allow users to escape stuck drill-down states in the portfolio-company view, improving navigation reliability.
